settings.heading: The questions we get asked most.

settings.question: How do I know which size to get?
settings.answer: Measure your dog from nose to base of tail while they're lying down, then add 15–20cm. If they're between two sizes, size up. Our size and firmness guide has the breed-by-breed detail, and the 100-night trial covers you if it's wrong.

settings.question: What does 50kg/m³ actually mean?
settings.answer: It's the density of the foam — how much material is packed into every cubic metre. Density isn't firmness: a low-density foam can feel firm on day one and collapse by month six. High-density foam keeps its structure under repeated weight, which is why we can guarantee it for five years.

settings.question: Will it help a dog with arthritis or hip problems?
settings.answer: Our beds are vet-informed and built to distribute weight so pressure isn't concentrated on hips, elbows and shoulders. A bed isn't a treatment and won't replace veterinary care, so please keep talking to your vet. What it can do is change the surface they spend fourteen hours a day on.

settings.question: Can I actually wash it?
settings.answer: Yes — properly, not just spot-clean. Every cover zips off and machine-washes at 30°C, over a waterproof inner liner that keeps everything off the foam.

settings.question: How quickly will it arrive?
settings.answer: Order by 3pm on a working day and it's dispatched from our Yorkshire workshop the same day. Delivery is free on UK orders over £40.

settings.question: What if my dog just won't use it?
settings.answer: Then it goes back and you're not out of pocket. Contact us inside 100 nights and we'll arrange the return and refund every penny. Full terms in our returns policy.
